title: Automated Due Reminder Sent to Cardholder with Masked Card Number
description: Verifies that an automated due reminder notification is sent to the cardholder, and that it contains only the last 4 digits of the card number to comply with privacy requirements. This ensures sensitive credit card data is handled safely and reminders are sent in a timely manner to reduce late payments. Automation: HIGH — pure API/UI assertions.
testDescription: When a customer's credit card account is nearing its payment due date, the system must automatically trigger a due reminder notification. The notification must contain the last 4 digits of the relevant credit card for identification and should not include or expose any other portion of the credit card number.
prerequisites: Active credit card account exists and is eligible for due reminder, due date is approaching within the notification window (e.g., 5 days), valid email or SMS address on file, background job scheduler is enabled.
stepsToPerform: 1. Log in to the system as a test user with an active credit card ending in 4242. 2. Ensure the test card's payment due date is set to 5 days from today. 3. Set account status to 'Current' and no missed payments. 4. Trigger or wait for the automated due reminder batch job to run. 5. Access the outbound notification log or the test email/SMS inbox for the user. 6. Locate the notification corresponding to the due reminder event. 7. Open and review the message content. 8. Assert that the notification contains only the last 4 digits of the credit card (e.g., 'ending in 4242'). 9. Assert that the rest of the credit card number is not present anywhere in the message. 10. Clean up and restore test data.
expectedResult: 1. Notification is sent automatically to the cardholder before the due date. 2. The notification displays only the last 4 digits of the card number and no other card number portion. 3. No full card number is present in the communication or logs.

stepsToPerform: 1. Log in as a test user with a credit card assigned. 2. Set the due date to 5 days from today. 3. Post a payment in full prior to the notification trigger. 4. Mark account as 'Paid' in the ledger/database. 5. Initiate automated due reminder batch job cycle. 6. Wait for job processing completion. 7. Access notification log or user's email/SMS inbox. 8. Search for due reminder messages linked to the account or user. 9. Verify absence of due reminder notification. 10. Clean up any test artifacts.
expectedResult: 1. No due reminder notification is sent or queued for delivery. 2. No record of a due reminder is found for the paid account in outbound communications logs or inboxes.

expectedResult: 1. Reminder is ONLY sent at the correct interval (e.g., exactly 5 days prior, or as defined in source). 2. No reminders sent before or after correct interval. 3. Notification timestamp matches trigger date.

title: End-to-End Collection Lifecycle: Reminder Through Legal Action
description: This scenario covers the full journey from issuing a due reminder, through each escalation, payment plan, collection agency handoff, and finally legal action, confirming that all state transitions, notifications, and privacy constraints occur correctly. It ensures regulatory and business workflow completeness.
testDescription: For a test customer who fails to pay a credit card balance, exercise the entire end-to-end timeline: (1) send Due Reminder; (2) escalate to Overdue Balance Alert after missed payment; (3) escalate to Collection Notification for significant delinquency; (4) offer Payment Plan Proposal; (5) refer the account to a Collection Agency; and (6) initiate Legal Action after continued nonresponse. At each step, verify notifications contain only last 4 digits, state transitions are correct, and audit trail is complete.
prerequisites: Test cardholder record with a live credit card (e.g., last 4 digits '5123'), Notification, account, and audit services online, User has authority to trigger all workflow steps.
stepsToPerform: 1. Login as authorized collections officer. 2. Identify test customer with upcoming due date (card ending 5123). 3. Trigger the Due Reminder notification and verify receipt with last 4 digits. 4. Mark payment as missed to move to overdue status. 5. Trigger Overdue Balance Alert and confirm correct recipient and masking. 6. Update account to significantly delinquent and trigger Collection Notification. 7. Offer a Payment Plan Proposal and verify notification content/privacy. 8. Upon continued delinquency, escalate account to Collection Agency and confirm agency receives only last 4 digits. 9. After continued nonresponse, trigger initiation of Legal Action and verify legal documentation references only card's last 4 digits. 10. Inspect audit trail/log for evidence of each event with proper fields and masking. 11. Check that notifications weren't sent out of order and all required states occurred. 12. Logout and document final lifecycle state.
expectedResult: At every stage, the notification is sent with only last 4 digits; state transitions execute in sequence; all actions are recorded in audit log; legal, privacy, and process compliance are maintained end-to-end.
